snippet.title: PlayStation - Douga de Puzzle! Puppukupu (1995)
snippet.description:
DESCRIPTION
Douga de Puzzle! Puppukupu is a Puzzle game, developed by Agenda and published by Argent, which was released in Japan in 1995.
